text:
Emily: Quick last-mile OKR check — two mins. What actually shipped for Qtr milestone A, what slipped, and who’s owning next steps for the slipped pieces? Please reply with 1) shipped / 2) slipped + blocker / 3) owner (who will own followups).

Sam: Shipped: runtime-v3 canary endpoints (text-gen + chat) on dedicated pool. Perf looks stable for 8k seq.

Sam: Slipped: autoscale policy tuning (will not hit target throughput for multi-tenant test). Blocker: infra autoscaler PR needs a lib bump and a DB migration window.

Priya: Shipped: product docs + evaluation harness for the new prompt sets. Acceptance tests: still failing in one edge-case rerank.

Ava: Slipped: rollout to eu-west for dedicated capacity (blocked by config sync mismatch). Owner: I can take next steps if infra clears the migration window.

Emily: Thanks — can owners confirm timelines? Sam, estimate for autoscale fix? Ava, who on infra do we ping for config sync?

Sam: I can own autoscale followups. ETA: 2 working days after infra merges the lib bump. CI link: https://ci.internal/teams/runtime/1234 — failing job is `autoscaler-integration`.

Jorge: Replied — I rebased the autoscaler PR and kicked CI. ETA for green: ~90–120m depending on DB migration approvals. Tagging infra leads: @Lara can you help with the migration window?

Lara: Yep, can do. I’ll coordinate with infra-schedule and open a migration window today 18:00-19:00 UTC. If CI passes before that, we can merge and promote earlier.

Priya: For the rerank edge-case: opened a quick PR with a test and mitigation. @Sam can you PTAL? PR: https://git.redwood/pri/rerank-fix. If we can merge, docs & evals are clear.

Sam: On it — will review in the next hour. If I see a problematic perf regression, I’ll flag here.

deploy-bot: deploy request received: `./deploy.sh runtime-v3 --canary` by Sam. Canary started for 3% traffic on us-east.

Ava: On eu-west: once Lara confirms migration window we’re good. I’ll hold the rollout until infra signals.

Emily: OK plan capture:
- Shipped: runtime-v3 canary, docs (partial). Owners: Sam + Priya.
- Slipped: autoscale tuning (Sam owner, blocked on infra PR + migrations), eu-west rollout (Ava owner, blocked on config sync/migration).
- Action items: Jorge to get CI green (in progress), Lara to open migration window (confirmed), Sam to review Priya's PR and finish autoscaler changes, Priya to merge docs post-fix.

Lara: Migration window opened: 2024-05-03 18:00-19:00 UTC. I posted on #eng-infra.

Sam: CI passed on autoscaler PR, reran integration, looks good. I’ll merge post-approval and kick smaller canary ramp.

Priya: Thanks — merged the rerank fix. Running evals now, will post results.

Emily: Cool — can owners post short done/blocked updates in this thread by EOD? I’ll roll this into the OKR snapshot doc tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Sam: Will do, pushing a small canary to 10% in ~30m after merge.

Ava: Will confirm eu-west rollout once Lara signals migration complete.

Jorge: CI green and smoke passed.

Priya: Evals passed for rerank fix, no regressions.

Emily: Great — thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here and I’ll update the doc.
